mapper.delete: DELETE FROM article_like_state WHERE user_id=#{author} OR article_id IN (SELECT id FROM article WHERE author_id=#{author})
DELETE c FROM article_like_count c JOIN article a ON a.id=c.article_id WHERE a.author_id=#{author}
DELETE r FROM article_tag r JOIN article a ON a.id = r.article_id WHERE a.author_id = #{author}
